## Scope

The quality audit covered a sample of graded sets selected for review. Each set was read again by a second grader to assess the consistency of grading decisions and identify any differences between the original and review outcomes. In total, 424 graded sets were included in the audit. The review was undertaken as part of routine quality assurance and provides an overall measure of agreement across the sample.

## Result

Overall agreement between the original grading and the second review was 64.6. This result indicates the level of consistency observed across the audited graded sets. Per-grader results are provided in the attached spreadsheet for further review. The findings will also be discussed privately with each grader, supporting clarification of any differences and identifying opportunities for consistent application of grading guidance.
